entities.summary: Warren Roger Whiteley is a South African former professional rugby union player for the Lions in Super Rugby, the Golden Lions in the Currie Cup and the Golden Lions XV in the Rugby Challenge. His regular playing position was eighthman. He has previously played for the Sharks and the Blitzbokke.
